evidence: PR #300: `takaro-maint build` run twice from a clean checkout, byte-identical artifacts; `takaro-maint install` and `takaro-maint deploy` run for real against the pinned Steam build (5.2 GB) on a maintainer's machine
support.notes: The first exact catalog target for this connector (#300). Steam pin of the public branch head observed 2026-09-25: tool app 4019830, Linux depot 3501791, build 25465077. The plugin's toolchain needs g++ on the same glibc as the dedicated server image; node:22.23.2-bookworm (not slim) is reused from the Dune: Awakening pin because it is the same base and already proven for this repository's script builds. `verification.required` is `contract` until this pin is proven at runtime: the plugin and sidecar unit/contract suites run on every build, but a real boot needs a Dragonwilds Linux dedicated server (~5.4 GB Steam depot) that a hosted runner does not install, so runtime levels are separate rather than claimed here.

notes: One image serves both halves of the build: the sidecar is TypeScript, and node:*-bookworm (not slim) carries the g++ the LD_PRELOAD plugin needs, on the same glibc as the dedicated server image (the same reasoning and the same pinned tag as the Dune: Awakening target). The server itself is a plain Steam depot install (no container images to load), so it installs through the shared Steam exact-install path like Conan Exiles rather than through Dune's arrangement.
